<thought>We need the count of aromatic carbons in the molecule, but no SMILES or structure is provided. The only way to infer this is to request the 13C NMR spectrum, which typically shows signals for aromatic carbons. We'll call the carbon_nmr_spectra tool to retrieve the spectrum and then count the aromatic carbon signals.</thought>
